review_comments.body:
This issue + sibling props are revealing some issues with how filtering/pinning is being managed currently that should change as part of this:

Each tree should independently expose filtered/full roots, match count, and pinnable IDs. Move the shared filter controls to `QueryResourceTree`, which should aggregate results, resolve pinned rows, and implement “Pin all.” Remove `siblingFilterMatchCount` and `SiblingPinning`; all cross-tree filtering/pinning composition belongs in the parent.
